nodes.text: and small boats. When they lay
in Solund, a man dreamed, the one
who was on the king's ship, who is
named Gyrd: he seemed to be standing there on
the king's ship and saw up on the island where
a great troll-woman stood, and she had
a short sword in one hand and in the other hand
a trough. He also seemed to see over all
their ships, and it seemed to him that a bird sat
on every ship's prow; these were all
eagles and ravens. The troll-woman spoke:
Certain it is that the sovereign from the east
is egged on to set course westward
